Methodology.title: How to read the public catalog
Methodology.description: What is visible, when values can be used, and what to check before comparing datasets.
Methodology.visibilityBody: Names, versions, scope, sources, and quality information can be browsed without an account. Inputs, outputs, and LCIA results appear only when they have been published for public use.
Methodology.comparabilityBody: If functional unit, reference flow, method, geography, time, or system boundary do not align, the Portal compares descriptive information only.
Methodology.provenanceBody: The Portal does not fill gaps, invent dataset groups, or present an AI suggestion as source data.
Methodology.withdrawalBody: Withdrawn or restricted content stops appearing. Versioned links and public releases update independently.
